questions.why: My parents = they; they ile are.
Yaş söylerken be kullanılır: I am 40 (years old). “I have 40” yanlıştır.

questions.q: You and I ____ in the same class.

questions.why: It’s, it is’in kısa hâlidir. Its (kesme işaretsiz) “onun” demektir.

reading.title: My family
reading.text: This is a photo of my family. I am Kerem and I am 35. My wife is Deniz. She is a dentist and she is very funny. Our children are Ela and Arda. Ela is eight and Arda is five. They are at a small school near our house. My parents are in Ankara. They are not young, but they are very active. My father is 68 and my mother is 64. We are a happy family.

o: She is a doctor in Ankara.

questions.q: What is true about Kerem’s parents?
questions.why: “They are not young, but they are very active.”

questions.q: How many children does Kerem have?

video.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 2: Hello, I'm Anna!

listening.intro: Anna, apartmandaki komşuları Jonathan ve Pete ile konuşuyor.

questions.why: Anna: “I am from a small town.”

questions.q: What does Jonathan say about Marsha?
o: She is from a small town.
questions.why: Jonathan: “I know Marsha. She is nice.”

questions.q: What does Pete tell Anna to do?
questions.why: Pete: “Remember to call Marsha at work.”

writing.prompt: Ailenizden ya da yakın bir arkadaşınızdan bahsedin: adı, yaşı, işi, nerede yaşadığı ve nasıl biri olduğu. is / are kullanın.
writing.prompt_en: Write about a family member or a close friend: name, age, job, where they live and what they are like.
writing.model: My best friend is Burak. He is 30 years old. He is a cook in a hotel in Bodrum. His job is very busy in summer. He is funny and kind. His wife is from Muğla. They are very happy together.

read: My parents are not young, but they are very active.
She is a dentist and she is very funny.

ask.q: Tell me about your family. Who are they?
ask.tr: Ailenizi anlatın: kimler var, kaç yaşındalar, ne iş yapıyorlar? En az üç cümle.
